profile.headline: Software & Audio Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineer with over 20 years of consulting and product experience building Java enterprise applications and advocating for agile transformation.

Specialties: Java enterprise application development, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), hibernate, Jenkins, agile development methodologies, Scrum, SAFe, eXtreme Programming, audio engineering, Salesforce.com development (Apex), cloud foundry, Predix

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Taliesin Technology Group provides software and audio engineering services. Software engineering services include Java enterprise application development and agile development methodologies. Audio engineering services include FOH engineering and audio/video production support.

Past clients include GE Capital Commercial Distribution Finance, SMBC Rail, and Stryker on behalf of the Signature Production Group and the B2 Group.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Engineer building cloud native software using agile methodologies (Scrum, XP, TDD). Held roles developing software and managing devops supporting ~15 daily production deployments.
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Cloud Build, Terraform, Jenkins, Bitbucket (git)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Digital Solutions | [Rail] Network Optimization
Smart Intermodal Management System
Smart Automotive Terminal

Tech lead for a Scrum (SAFe) team developing Predix (Cloud Foundry) based industrial IoT solutions to optimize operations at automotive and intermodal rail yards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer focused on Java, Flex, and Ruby development utilizing open source frameworks and software and agile development methodologies.
- Developed new features for the flagship TrustKeeper PCI Manager product.
- Developed code in Java, Flex, and Ruby.
- Utilized Apache Tomcat, MySQL, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Maven, and Jenkins.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior developer primarily focused on Java development utilizing open source tools and frameworks.
- Developed back-end Java code for a virtual stock trading site: http://www.weseed.com/
- Developed REST based services using the Spring Framework, Hibernate, and Jersey.
- Maintained a Ruby on Rails based front-end that consumed REST back-end services.
- Drove the use of agile development methodologies, e.g., Test Driven Development (TDD), agile planning, user stories.
- Administered cgit and Review Board to facilitate and promote code reviews across a geographically distributed team.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Led technical teams to deliver projects for Glenture's clients. Involved in the entire project life cycle, including lead generation, drafting and pitching proposals and statements of work, resource estimation and allocation, and software design and development.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Enterprise Java software development using J2EE, Apache Struts, and Oracle.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Enterprise Java software development using J2EE and open source technologies.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Built websites for .com companies using Java (J2EE) based technologies.
- Piloted the use of eXtreme Programming and other agile methodologies to deliver client projects.

positions.description: A1 for 1-2 shows a week. Mixed local and national acts.

positions.description: FOH audio engineer for live bands and events at The Courtyard Café and other venues at the Illini Union.

projects.title: Stryker Spine National Sales Meeting 2014
projects.description:
• Subcontractor for Signature Production Group and the B2Group
• Provided show support for the Stryker Spine National Sales Meeting 2014.
• Ran a breakout session room (~100 people/session): mixing audio and providing video support.
• Assisted in load in/out, assembly of the main set and lighting truss, pre-flight preparation of the line array, ran and dressed cables for audio, video, lighting, and comms, setup and tear down of multiple breakout session rooms and digital signage.
